title: Made runtime context changes traceable
points: Router runtime now preserves valid resolved ticker scope when raw user text contains an alias-like invalid token, instead of rewriting the plan as out-of-universe.
Numeric filing-page extractions now become model-visible workpaper tables when no stronger aggregate table is available, so the analyst sees the extracted evidence instead of only trace previews.
Admin traces now expose router raw/normalized plans, runtime intervention before/after snapshots, and analyst citation tag selection for context-quality review.
